procedural_matters: Jan Kemp attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: AUS 3 was aware of her score of DSQ in race 1 as a result of an incomplete appendix P penalty, on 2026-02-23 on water after she finished the race.
The protest time limit on 2026-02-23 was 17h15.
The request was lodged on 2026-02-24 at 10h51.
conclusions: AUS 3 failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit
There was no good reason for the PC to extend the time.
Therefore the request for redress is invalid under RRS 61.3.
decision: The request is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
